general_directive: Make a single photograph of the specified scene, with an ordinary documentary capture rather than a promotional treatment. Retain the described activity, objects, weather and time of day, and follow the separate camera-composition instruction. Use available light motivated by the scene: sky, windows or existing practical lamps; preserve plausible falloff, mixed light and local shadows. Do not add studio lights unless the scene explicitly requires them. Treat the exposure below as a starting target: adjust sensitivity within its range for the available light, and only depart from shutter/aperture when necessary for a plausible exposure or subject motion. Keep optical perspective, focus and depth of field consistent with the device, lens and distance. Do not apply a default cinematic grade, beauty retouching, excessive HDR or uniformly blurred backgrounds. Do not add grain, blur, damage or JPEG blocks as a compulsory authenticity effect. Choose portrait, landscape or square proportions to suit the scene. Device and exposure instructions describe the intended appearance; do not put labels, camera branding, settings or watermarks in the picture.
template: Capture device: {camera_class}; sensor: {sensor_format}. Lens angle of view: {focal_length_equiv_mm} mm equivalent on 35 mm full frame; this is an equivalent focal length, not a claim about sensor size. Exposure target: f/{aperture_f}, 1/{shutter_denominator} s, Auto ISO {iso_min}-{iso_max}. Preferred working distance: {distance_min_m}-{distance_max_m} m, adjusted to retain the scene and coherent framing rather than moving its objects. Focus and depth: {focus}. File rendering: {processing}.

profiles.camera_class: an ordinary smartphone main rear camera
profiles.focus: autofocus on the main activity or object, with the substantial contextual depth expected of a small sensor; no simulated portrait-mode separation
profiles.processing: a normal phone JPEG, restrained computational highlight recovery and modest edge sharpening; neutral automatic white balance that can retain local warm or cool light; fine shadow noise only where sensitivity and illumination justify it

profiles.focus: broad depth of field across the nearby setting, plausible wide-angle perspective and mild edge stretching without a fisheye effect
profiles.processing: a standard corrected phone JPEG with moderate contrast, slightly less edge detail than the image center and restrained sharpening; preserve the actual light rather than imposing a vivid travel-photo grade

profiles.camera_class: a late-2000s consumer compact digital camera with a zoom lens
profiles.focus: single-point autofocus on the main subject with broad depth across the setting and slightly softer corners; no artificial background cutout
profiles.processing: an in-camera JPEG with ordinary saturation, modest edge contrast and limited highlight latitude; allow only subtle sensitivity-dependent chroma noise and detail loss in shadows, with no retro filter or added date stamp

profiles.camera_class: an entry-level APS-C DSLR with an 18-55 mm kit zoom near its wide end
profiles.sensor_format: APS-C digital with approximately 1.5x crop factor
profiles.focus: focus on the principal activity plane, retaining readable foreground and background with a gradual optical transition rather than extreme bokeh
profiles.processing: a standard camera JPEG with neutral color, moderate sharpening and ordinary highlight clipping where physically warranted; no local-contrast treatment or polished real-estate rendering

profiles.camera_class: a full-frame digital camera with a normal 50 mm lens
profiles.focus: focus on the main subject with moderate optical depth, preserving surrounding context; background softness must follow actual distance and aperture rather than a universal portrait look
profiles.processing: a restrained neutral conversion with natural texture, moderate tonal range and no conspicuous film emulation, glossy commercial finish or automatic golden-hour lighting

profiles.camera_class: a consumer Micro Four Thirds mirrorless camera with a standard zoom
profiles.sensor_format: 17.3 x 13 mm digital with approximately 2x crop factor
profiles.focus: a single natural focus plane on the subject and moderate contextual depth; allow a gradual loss of distant detail without masking objects out of focus
profiles.processing: an ordinary in-camera JPEG with conservative noise reduction, subtle fine texture at high sensitivity, neutral white balance and no selective color or exaggerated microcontrast
